listening.title: A Progress Review With the Client

lines.speaker: Phong
lines.text: Good morning, Sarah. Thanks for joining our progress review today.

lines.speaker: Sarah (client)
lines.text: Good morning, Phong. I'm looking forward to the detailed overview of the new module.

lines.speaker: Phong
lines.text: Great, we'll start with a quick summary from our requirement gathering last month.

lines.speaker: Sarah (client)
lines.text: Perfect. I do want to raise one thing about the checkout feature.

lines.speaker: Phong
lines.text: Of course, please share your concern and I'll do my best to resolve it.

lines.speaker: Sarah (client)
lines.text: We noticed a few extra requests came in, and I'm worried about scope creep.

lines.speaker: Phong
lines.text: That's a fair point. I'll be your point of contact if anything changes this phase.

lines.speaker: Sarah (client)
lines.text: Agreed. Can you send me a list of follow-up tasks after this call?

lines.speaker: Phong
lines.text: Definitely. I'll also loop in our client-facing coordinator for daily updates.

lines.speaker: Sarah (client)
lines.text: Sounds good. Let's confirm the next steps before we wrap up.
